parameters.content:
## Enable Banking Token Renewal (spec 005 section 4.2.1)
Daily check reads both finance Secrets through the k8s API with the pod's own ServiceAccount (Role n8n-finance-secrets).

- valid_until within 3 days -> Slack nudge to #workflows with the renewal form link
- Form: submit -> POST /auth -> Form Ending redirect to the bank consent
- Bank redirect lands on /webhook/enablebanking-consent?code=... -> POST /sessions -> upsert finance-enablebanking-token -> Slack confirm

The bank login itself is the manual PSD2 step and cannot be automated. The consent URL whitelisted on the Enable Banking application must be exactly https://automation-n8n.homelab.alvsanand.com/webhook/enablebanking-consent

nodes.name: Daily Check
nodes.notes: Runs before the 06:00 finance DAG so a renewal decided today is in the Secret before the next ingest.
